papers_read.title_as_printed: Identifying underlying patterns in Alzheimer's disease trajectory: a deep learning approach and Mendelian randomization analysis (Yi et al., eClinicalMedicine 2023)
Longitudinal multi-modal data prediction model for mild cognitive impairment by deep survival analysis (Zhang et al., BMC Med Inform Decis Mak 2026, article in press)

what_each_reports.P-244: Deep-AD survival clustering on baseline clinical plus FreeSurfer sMRI features, 5-fold CV in ADNI. AUC 0.802 is for CN-to-MCI at 3 years (0.876 at 5 years); for MCI-to-AD the AUCs are 0.914 at 3 years and 0.957 at 5 years (range 0.810-0.979 over 1-10 years); MCI-to-AD C-index 0.718; AIBL external C-index 0.752.
what_each_reports.P-353: tdCoxSNN on baseline demographics/APOE plus longitudinal neuropsychological (11 tests) and sMRI (116 AAL ROI) measures, 922 ADNI MCI, 20% held-out test set: cumulative/dynamic AUC 0.9089 +/- 0.01 at t = 1 year after landmark s = 1 year, MCI-to-AD.

quantity_a: The record's figure (0.802) is a time-dependent ROC-AUC for CN-to-MCI conversion at 3 years in cognitively normal ADNI participants (n = 587); P-244's MCI-to-AD 3-year AUC is 0.914.
quantity_b: Cumulative/dynamic AUC for MCI-to-AD conversion within 1 year after a 1-year landmark, using longitudinal predictors accumulated to the landmark, ADNI MCI test set (n = 184).
incompatible_if_same: No. On the nearest comparable quantity (MCI-to-AD) P-244 reports 0.914 at 3 years and 0.810-0.979 across horizons, which brackets P-353's 0.909; the two agree rather than conflict.

gates.task: mismatch for the figure used: P-244's 0.802 is a CN-to-MCI transition, not T2 MCI-to-AD; P-244's MCI-to-AD arm is T2 and matches P-353.
gates.dataset_family: match: both ADNI (P-244 additionally AIBL external).
gates.validation_tier: P-244 5-fold CV plus AIBL external C-index; P-353 internal held-out test set only; AUCs compared are both internal (V2).
gates.modality_family: match in broad terms: both clinical/neuropsychological plus structural-MRI ROI features (P-244 baseline only; P-353 longitudinal).

endpoint_and_metric: incompatible as recorded: different transition (CN-to-MCI vs MCI-to-AD) and horizon (3-year from baseline vs 1-year after a 1-year landmark), and time-dependent ROC-AUC vs cumulative/dynamic AUC on a landmarked dynamic model.
performance_validity: flag does not apply: neither figure meets the ceiling test and both papers have n > 500; P-244's 0.957-0.979 long-horizon values are not the contested figures.
independence: Shared cohort: both use ADNI MCI participants (non-independence recorded); no shared authors.
grounds: The record's claim for P-244 misreads its paper: 0.802 is the 3-year CN-to-MCI AUC, not an MCI-to-AD (T2) result.
P-244's own MCI-to-AD AUC at 3 years is 0.914, essentially equal to P-353's 0.909, so on the comparable transition the papers agree.
Even setting the misreading aside, horizons and AUC constructions differ (3 years from baseline vs 1 year after a landmark with longitudinal inputs), so no incompatibility on one quantity is present.

evidence_quotes.quote: AUC (CN→MCI, 3 years 0.802, 5 years 0.876; MCI→AD, 3 years 0.914, 5 years 0.957)
with an AUC of 0.708–0.886 and 0.810–0.979 on the CN→MCI and MCI→AD cohorts, respectively.

attaining cdAUC values of 0.9089±0.01 alongside BS of 0.1651±0.01 with t =1 year on the test set

record_defects: claim_a 'P-244: AUC 0.802 on T2' is wrong: 0.802 is the CN-to-MCI 3-year AUC; P-244's MCI-to-AD 3-year AUC is 0.914.
P-244's registry Best_Metric 'AUC 0.802' and Sample_N_Approx 587 both come from the CN-to-MCI dataset, although the row is coded T2 (MCI-to-AD dataset n = 783).
modality_family 'clinical_survey' understates both papers, which model sMRI ROI features with clinical variables.
P-353's 'AUC 0.91' is a cumulative/dynamic AUC at a 1-year horizon after a 1-year landmark, not a baseline ROC-AUC; the record carries no horizon.
The resolution_note still names P-320 (repointed to P-81) and its bridging list documents score variance, not a separating condition.
what_would_change_the_verdict: Nothing on these two documents: the like-for-like MCI-to-AD figures (0.914 vs 0.909) agree. A conflict would need a P-244 MCI-to-AD AUC at a matched 1-year landmarked horizon far below P-353's, which P-244 does not report.
